title: DSM-Firmenich sales top €2.3 billion in Q3 2026 due to volume-led growth
summary: The fragrance and flavour company’s earnings were bolstered by its fine fragrance offering, alongside benefiting from reformulations across its beauty portfolio

extraction.key_fact: DSM-Firmenich의 3분기 실적이 고급 향수 부문과 처방 재설계 수요로 늘었다.
